question:
The figure below shows the path of a ray of light through a triangular glass prism. The angle of incidence and angle of deviation in the respective order are given by:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/11bf414ceb07147e2f03fbee3884fe76e1474b02eff27c6c5682739fa2708008.png]
solution:
The correct answer is __**∠ABN and ∠EOD **__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The angle of incidence and angle of deviation in the path of a ray of light through a triangular glass prism are **∠ABN and ∠EOD** respectively.
 
• In the given options, **Option 3** correctly identifies these angles.
 
• The angle of incidence is where the ray enters the prism, and the angle of deviation is the angle between the incident ray and the emergent ray.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• When light enters a prism, it bends towards the normal due to **refraction**.
 
• Upon exiting the prism, the light bends away from the normal, causing a deviation from its original path.
 
• The amount of deviation depends on the angle of incidence, the angle of the prism, and the refractive index of the material of the prism.
